text:
Which statements about the thermal decomposition of copper(II) nitrate are correct?
1
A brown gas is given off.
2
A gas which relights a glowing splint is given off.
3
The solid residue is an acidic oxide.
A
1 only
B
1 and 2
C
1 and 3
D
2 and 3
subject: Chemistry
